title: OwedInput
description: Something only an outside party can give, recorded by a reviewer or an evidence requirement (docs/design/m0/04 "Owed inputs"). The dependent work holds on awaiting_input. A ruling or data input is answered by an input.answer approval binding its revision; a receipt input is satisfied only by an applicable receipt, never by a ruling. It is the payload of owed_input.recorded/v1: a later record of the same id is its next revision, of the same project, node and kind.

requested_by.description: The graph node that asked: only an answer input of a node in its lineage takes the answer (docs/design/m0/13 "Successor rounds").

owner.description: The grant holder the awaiting_input hold waits on (schemas/vocab/holds.yaml): a live operator or supervisor.

revision.description: The owed input's revision; an answer binds it, so a changed question needs a new answer.
